| Goal | Delivered evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Clear boundaries | Canonical quality goals distinguish mandatory outcomes from methods; authority, safety, review and merge boundaries remain explicit |
| Stable outcomes | Source skills, generated guide, policies, templates, README and maintained example route to consistent canonical contracts; compatibility tests preserve v2/v3/v4 behavior |
| Key information only | PR-primary findings and Git-retrievable candidates replace duplicate full-file review copies while unique evidence and checker snapshots remain |
| Proportional effort | Authorized work units and coherent review packages replace per-edit stops without removing checks or phase acceptance |
| Agent discretion | Agents choose internal sequence and safe recovery within approved scope; critical authority, contract or safety uncertainty still escalates |

Exception triage classifies responsible layer separately from severity. Agent
mistakes are corrected within authority; genuine project/playbook gaps are
deduplicated in their proper trackers; unaffected work may continue when safely
isolated. Consumers link the canonical recovery framework rather than restating it.
